stem.text: Why can an observable interference pattern **never** be obtained between two monochromatic beams of light from different lamps?

A.text: The frequency of the light from the two lamps can never be the same.

B.text: The light from the two lamps can never be coherent.

C.text: The temperature of the filaments of the two lamps used can never be the same.

D.text: The wavelength of the light from the two lamps must always be different.
